widgets_values: Character turnaround sheet, four full-body views side by side on a plain light grey studio background: front, three-quarter front, side profile, and back. Same face, hair, build and clothes in every view. In the side and back views they hold a phone up at eye level in both hands, taking a photo. Photographic, even lighting. If ref_image_0 shows a person, it is them, exactly; if not, the character is the anonymous everyday person described here. The character: <the person in the profile picture>

ref_image_0 is a bystander's view of a real place. The solid magenta areas are where the camera sees past what was photographed: they are missing, not part of the place. Extend the place outward into every magenta area so it fills the whole frame, with more of the same place, same light, same lens: no border, no frame, no magenta left. Keep everything else exactly as it is. No people in the foreground. <the place, the light and the subject of the photo>
